"""Capture transport, framing and record rejection tests."""
import base64, copy, io, sys, zlib
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from harness import run
import zstandard as zstd

HEADER=('type,id,revision,published,op,lease,event,probe,target,responder,'
        'result,service,attempt,payload')
GOOD_LEASE={'id':'home','prefix':'2001:db8:1:1200::/56','start':0,'end':100,
            'subnets':[0],'low_count':2}
CANARY='2001:db8:1:1200:e22c:bc0:ce5b:ffd'

def job(rows,encoding='csv',extra=None,queries=(10,)):
    if encoding=='csv':
        data=('\r\n'.join([HEADER]+rows)+'\r\n').encode()
        chunks=[base64.b64encode(data).decode()]
    else:
        data=('\r\n'.join([HEADER]+rows)+'\r\n').encode()
        chunks=[base64.b64encode(zstd.ZstdCompressor().compress(data)).decode()]
    out={'version':3,'seed':'demo','leases':[GOOD_LEASE],'queries':list(queries),
         'services':[{'id':'web','kind':'tcp'},{'id':'adb','kind':'adb'},
                     {'id':'sync','kind':'sync'}],
         'captures':[{'encoding':encoding,'chunks':chunks}],
         'requests':[],'offers':[],
         'request_quotas':[{'id':'g','parent':None,'capacity':4}],
         'offer_quotas':[{'id':'o','parent':None,'capacity':4}]}
    if extra: out.update(extra)
    return out

def expect(label,got,want):
    if got!={'error':want}:
        print('FAIL',label,'->',str(got)[:300])
        return False
    return True

ok=True
# 1 echo row (canary self echo makes the lease aliased)
ok&=expect('canary self echo',run(job([f'icmp,seen,0,1,put,home,1,0/c,{CANARY},{CANARY},echo,,,'])),
           'invalid')  # aliased lease is fine, not an error
# basic valid row
rows=[f'icmp,seen,0,1,put,home,1,0/i1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,echo,,,']
out=run(job(rows))
if out.get('rejected') or out['snapshots'][0]['ledger']!={'live':1,'deleted':0,'conflict':0}:
    print('FAIL basic',out['snapshots'][0]['ledger'],out['rejected']); ok=False

# bad base64 chunk
j=job([]); j['captures'][0]['chunks']=['not//base64!!']
ok&=expect('bad base64',run(j),'capture')
# truncated zstd
j=job([],encoding='zstd')
raw=base64.b64decode(j['captures'][0]['chunks'][0])
j['captures'][0]['chunks']=[base64.b64encode(raw[:-4]).decode()]
ok&=expect('truncated zstd',run(j),'capture')
# corrupted checksum
j=job([],encoding='zstd')
raw=bytearray(base64.b64decode(j['captures'][0]['chunks'][0])); raw[-1]^=0xff
j['captures'][0]['chunks']=[base64.b64encode(bytes(raw)).decode()]
ok&=expect('bad checksum',run(j),'capture')
# reserved bit
cctx=zstd.ZstdCompressor(write_checksum=False,write_content_size=True)
frame=bytearray(cctx.compress(b'x'*100)); frame[4]^=0x08
j={'version':3,'seed':'demo','leases':[GOOD_LEASE],'queries':[10],'services':[],
   'captures':[{'encoding':'zstd','chunks':[base64.b64encode(bytes(frame)).decode()]}],
   'requests':[],'offers':[],'request_quotas':[],'offer_quotas':[]}
ok&=expect('reserved bit',run(j),'capture')
# unused bit ignored
frame2=bytearray(cctx.compress(b'x'*100)); frame2[4]^=0x10
j['captures'][0]['chunks']=[base64.b64encode(bytes(frame2)).decode()]
if run(j).get('error'): print('FAIL unused bit',run(j)); ok=False
# dictionary id
params=zstd.ZstdCompressionParameters.from_level(3,format=zstd.FORMAT_ZSTD1_MAGICLESS)
try:
    cdict=zstd.ZstdCompressionDict(b'a'*4096)
    dct=zstd.ZstdCompressor(dict_data=cdict,write_content_size=True)
    df=dct.compress(b'x'*100)
    j['captures'][0]['chunks']=[base64.b64encode(df).decode()]
    ok&=expect('dictionary',run(j),'capture')
except Exception as exc:
    print('skip dictionary test',exc)
# window too large
big=zstd.ZstdCompressionParameters.from_level(1,window_log=27)
cctx2=zstd.ZstdCompressor(compression_params=big,write_content_size=True)
wf=cctx2.compress(b'y'*1000)
j['captures'][0]['chunks']=[base64.b64encode(wf).decode()]
if run(j).get('error'): print('FAIL window 128MiB accepted',run(j)); ok=False
params=zstd.ZstdCompressionParameters.from_level(1,window_log=28)
cctx3=zstd.ZstdCompressor(compression_params=params,write_content_size=True)
wf=cctx3.compress(b'y'*1000)
j['captures'][0]['chunks']=[base64.b64encode(wf).decode()]
ok&=expect('window too big',run(j),'capture')
# trailing garbage after frames
j=job([],encoding='zstd')
raw=base64.b64decode(j['captures'][0]['chunks'][0])+b'garbage'
j['captures'][0]['chunks']=[base64.b64encode(raw).decode()]
ok&=expect('trailing garbage',run(j),'capture')
# skippable + concatenated frames
f1=cctx.compress(HEADER.encode())
f2=cctx.compress(b'icmp,seen,0,1,put,home,1,0/i1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,echo,,,\r\n')
skip=b'\x50\x2a\x4d\x18'+(4).to_bytes(4,'little')+b'abcd'
payload=skip+f1+f2
j={'version':3,'seed':'demo','leases':[GOOD_LEASE],'queries':[10],'services':[],
   'captures':[{'encoding':'zstd','chunks':[base64.b64encode(payload).decode()]}],
   'requests':[],'offers':[],'request_quotas':[],'offer_quotas':[]}
out=run(j)
if out.get('error') or out['snapshots'][0]['ledger']['live']!=1:
    print('FAIL skippable',out); ok=False
# chunks split across frame and record boundaries
pieces=[payload[i:i+7] for i in range(0,len(payload),7)]
j['captures'][0]['chunks']=[base64.b64encode(p).decode() for p in pieces]
out=run(j)
if out.get('error') or out['snapshots'][0]['ledger']['live']!=1:
    print('FAIL split chunks',out); ok=False
# empty chunks allowed
j['captures'][0]['chunks']=['']+j['captures'][0]['chunks'][-1:]+['']
out=run(j)
if out.get('error'): print('FAIL empty chunk',out); ok=False
# invalid utf-8
j=job([f'icmp,seen,0,1,put,home,1,0/i1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,echo,,,'])
data=bytearray(base64.b64decode(j['captures'][0]['chunks'][0]))
data[-4:-3]=b'\xff'
j['captures'][0]['chunks']=[base64.b64encode(bytes(data)).decode()]
ok&=expect('invalid utf8',run(j),'capture')
# wrong header
j=job([])
data=bytearray(base64.b64decode(j['captures'][0]['chunks'][0]))
j['captures'][0]['chunks']=[base64.b64encode(bytes(data).replace(b'type,id',b'type,id,id')).decode()]
ok&=expect('wrong header',run(j),'capture')
# empty capture
j=job([]); j['captures'][0]['chunks']=[base64.b64encode(b'').decode()]
ok&=expect('empty capture',run(j),'capture')
# csv syntax error: bare quote inside unquoted field
j=job(['icmp,seen,0,1,put,home,1,0/i1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,ech"o,,,'])
ok&=expect('bad quote',run(j),'capture')
# quoted field with embedded newline and doubled quotes
row=('icmp,"se""en",0,1,put,home,1,0/i1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,\r\necho,,,')
out=run(job([row]))
if out.get('error'):
    print('FAIL quoted newline',out); ok=False
elif out['snapshots'][0]['ledger']['live']!=1:
    print('FAIL quoted newline ledger',out['snapshots'][0]); ok=False
# blank record counts and is malformed
out=run(job(['',f'icmp,seen,0,1,put,home,1,0/i1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,echo,,,']))
if out.get('error') or out['rejected']!=[[0,0]] or out['snapshots'][0]['ledger']['live']!=1:
    print('FAIL blank record',out); ok=False
# wrong field count
out=run(job(['icmp,seen,0,1,put,home,1,0/i1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,echo,,']))
if out.get('error') or out['rejected']!=[[0,0]]:
    print('FAIL field count',out); ok=False
# record budget
many=['icmp,seen,0,1,put,home,1,0/i1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,echo,,,']*200001
ok&=expect('record budget',run(job(many)),'capture')
# field budget
long_field='a'*131073
out=run(job([f'icmp,{long_field},0,1,put,home,1,0/i1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,echo,,,']))
if out!={'error':'capture'}:
    print('FAIL field budget',str(out)[:120]); ok=False
# decoded budget: 33 MiB of csv in one capture
j=job([])
data=(HEADER+'\r\n'+('icmp,seen,0,1,put,home,1,0/i1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,echo,,,\r\n')*270000)
j['captures'][0]['chunks']=[base64.b64encode(data.encode()).decode()]
out=run(j)
if out!={'error':'capture'}:
    print('FAIL decompressed budget',str(out)[:200]); ok=False
print('capture tests done, ok =',bool(ok))
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/t_capture.py
